summary: CWE-253: FileInputStream.read(byte[]) returns the number of bytes read, or -1 when the stream has reached end-of-file; it does not return 0 to signal that nothing was read. Checking the result against 0 misinterprets the return value, so a genuine end-of-file/no-data condition is never detected and the else branch decodes an unfilled buffer. The fix compares the return value against -1, the correct sentinel, preserving normal reads while properly handling the end-of-file case.
